g.text: Do lower scores actually flag mistakes?
Error-detection curves on the 500 held-out messages; cutoffs were chosen elsewhere.
Circle: probability rule; diamond: Jev native rule. Cutoffs frozen on 200 separate messages. Dashed line: 5% target.
Dotted line: random deferral among valid responses; request failures always deferred. Curves are descriptive only.
